answers.reusableForAccessories: Existing offer, price, availability, optional affiliate, compatibility and Amazon link primitives.
answers.missingFields: A persisted accessory ASIN/merchantLinks representation and verified commerce status would be needed only for later automation; neither is required for this internal report.
answers.verificationSource: Runtime resolver input plus configured Amazon tracking ID; no stored accessory verification flag exists.
answers.amazonDerivationLimits: Requires exact ASIN/direct product URL, exact compatible item and pack, current purchase availability and configured mechanism; search URLs are rejected.
answers.nonPrimaryOfferSupport: Storage and validation exist for consumables and replacement parts; rendering, automated affiliate resolution and price refresh do not.
